items.title: Senior Social Media Manager
items.location_text: Mountain View, CA; San Francisco, CA
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role Glean is looking for a Senior Social Media Manager to own and grow our organic social presence across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. You'll be the voice behind Glean's brand channels and a key partner to our executives and technical leaders, turning product launches, company moments, and market conversations into content that educates, celebrates, and inspires the use of Work AI. This is a hands-on role for someone who moves fluidly between real-time execution (live-posting a launch event) and longer-range program building (scaling an employee advocacy program, standing up a technical social-listening motion). You'll report to the Director of Communications and work closely with Product Marketing, Content & Thought Leadership, PR, Sales, and R&D to make sure Glean shows up consistently and credibly everywhere our audience is paying attention. You Will: Own Glean's always-on content calendar and organic social strategy across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, aligned to our content pillars: educate, celebrate, and inspire the use of Glean's Work AI platform. Create and edit lightweight, platform-native multimedia content - including short-form video, clips, graphics, and other social-first assets - using tools such as Capcut, Canva, or other. Manage executive social media presence for Glean's CEO and other company spokespeople — ghostwriting, scheduling, and coordinating posts that tie technical and company narratives to the broader Work AI story. Lead live social coverage for major company moments, including product launches, Monthly Drops, and flagship events (e.g., Glean:GO), publishing and amplifying content in real time across channels. Own and scale Glean's employee advocacy program (currently run via Oktopost) — onboarding and training advocates, curating ready-to-share content, managing the licensing/vendor relationship and renewals, and reporting on reach, engagement, and pipeline attribution (in partnership with Sales/SFDC). Build and run a technical social-listening and rapid-response motion (e.g., a "Glean Gurus"-style program) with R&D and PMM, surfacing and engaging in relevant conversations on X, Reddit, and other technical forums. Partner with Sales and Sales Enablement to train employees on social best practices and personal branding, and run onboarding sessions on how to engage safely and effectively on behalf of the brand. Manage relationships with outside agencies or contractors supporting content production, cross-posting, and coverage during high-volume periods. Track and report on social performance (reach, engagement, follower growth, and pipeline/revenue influence) and translate insights into content and channel strategy recommendations. Monitor brand sentiment and competitive conversation, applying sound judgment on when and how to engage, and act as a first line of defense on social-related reputational risk. Collaborate cross-functionally with Communications, PR, Product Marketing, Content & Thought Leadership, and R&D to ensure social amplifies — and helps shape — the broader company narrative. About You: 6+ years of experience managing organic social media for a B2B or enterprise technology/SaaS brand, ideally with direct ownership of a corporate LinkedIn and X presence. Experience managing or ghostwriting for executive social accounts, with strong instincts for voice, tone, and what's appropriate to post on a leader's behalf. Experience running or scaling an employee advocacy or social amplification program (e.g., Oktopost, EveryoneSocial, GaggleAMP) with measurable results. Comfort operating in real time — live-posting events, responding quickly to trending conversations, and making fast, sound judgment calls under time pressure. Strong writing skills and an editorial eye, with the ability to translate technical or dense product content into clear, platform-native copy. A data-driven approach to social, with experience using analytics tools to measure performance and tie social activity to pipeline or business outcomes. Experience partnering cross-functionally with Communications, PR, Product Marketing, Sales, and Engineering/R&D stakeholders. Strong technical fluency, with the ability to quickly understand complex AI, product, and engineering concepts and translate them into accurate, accessible, and compelling social content. Vendor and budget management experience (agencies, social tooling contracts) is a plus. Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office). Availability for occasional evening/early-morning coverage around major launches and events. Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $172,000 - $198,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. This role is based in San Francisco, CA, but you will be expected to travel to project sites regularly, aligned with project requirements. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Lead full lifecycle execution of a range of infrastructure and facilities build-out projects simultaneously, including advanced compute facilities, labs, testing environments, and production spaces. - Own detailed project estimating, budgeting, and financial analysis to ensure fiscal responsibility and efficiency. This includes securing capital funding - Engage, contract and drive external partners (architects, contractors, construction managers and other consultants) to deliver mission-critical projects on accelerated timelines - Collaborate closely on projects with internal teams like Real Estate, Operations, Corporate Security, IT/AV, EH&S, stakeholder team and Finance - Partner closely with Leasing on site selection, providing due diligence and cost forecasting to support site acquisition - Own the relationship with internal clients and executives, driving engagement, alignment, and decision-making. - Develop and oversee technical due diligence efforts for each project, which may include technical assessments, AHJ coordination, utility requirements and feasibility studies. - Develop and review concept designs, which will define programming that is aligned with all stakeholders and guide design development. - Review and contribute to design drawings, mechanical and electrical layouts, utility diagrams, specifications, and technical documentation. items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. Senior Product Manager, Money Movement Experiences Menlo Park, CA Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you're ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Money Movement team builds the products that let customers move money and assets into, out of, and within Robinhood. Our work spans the infrastructure and partner integrations underneath and the experiences customers see on top, and we partner closely with design, data science, compliance, and fraud. Moving money is where customers decide whether they trust a product, and we want it to feel as good as investing. We care a lot about removing friction. A transfer should be fast and easy to follow, with the kind of polish customers notice. Everything else customers do at Robinhood starts here, so we want it to be something they enjoy. As a Senior Product Manager on the customer experience side of Money Movement, you will set the vision for how moving money feels and deliver experiences customers find clear and delightful. You will lead zero-to-one launches, own the end-to-end journey across mobile and web, and sweat the details, from the copy and motion to the states in between. You will partner with design, engineering, legal, and operations to ensure what we ship is compliant and a pleasure to use. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you'll do Define the long-term product vision and roadmap for Robinhood's money movement customer experience, spanning funding, deposits, withdrawals, and transfers Lead zero-to-one product initiatives that make moving money faster and more delightful, from first concept through launch Partner closely with design to shape the work, give and receive sharp critique, and hold a high bar for craft and interaction detail Drive significant improvements in funnel conversion, transaction success, and customer satisfaction by finding friction and failure points in the journey and using research, experimentation, and analytics to prioritize Partner with engineering and the platform teams that own our payment rails and vendor integrations to turn platform capabilities into reliable, fast customer-facing experiences Work with compliance, legal, and fraud teams to ensure every experience meets regulatory requirements without compromising the customer experience What you bring Bachelor's, Master's, or equivalent experience 5+ years of experience in a product management role, with a proven track record of shipping consumer products that customers love, ideally mobile-first A history of close collaboration with design: you partner with designers from concept to launch, give and receive sharp critique, and hold a high bar for craft Exceptional attention to detail and strong product taste, with examples of experiences you shaped where polish made a measurable difference Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated consumer space is a plus; you do not need to be a payments expert, and you will learn the rest quickly High technical empathy and experience partnering closely with engineering to resolve complex tradeoffs and deliver clean user experiences Familiarity using user research, experimentation, and product analytics to guide decision making Demonstrated ability to navigate extreme ambiguity, formulate opinionated product recommendations, and drive alignment across senior stakeholders A strong sense of urgency and speed, high standards, and a strong work ethic: you always bring your best and expect your colleagues to do the same Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with design, engineering, operations, and external partners What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet: a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - AI Infra - SF
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development. About the role Forward Deployed Engineers lead complex deployments of frontier models in production. You will embed with customers where model performance matters, delivery is urgent, and ambiguity is the default. You will use this to map their problems, structure delivery, and ship fast. As a Forward Deployed Engineer for AI Infra, you will work directly with customer engineers, researchers and product engineers on optimization problems across semiconductors and AI infrastructure. You will write and debug software, run experiments against real workloads and hardware, and improve the tools and product used across engagements. You will help define the problem and success criteria, build the software needed to test an approach, and stay with the work through validation and deployment. Work may include inference performance and chip-design optimization. Success means producing results that stand up to correctness and performance checks, and contributing improvements that other engagements can use. Success in this role means owning the delivery state across workstreams. You will hold the bar on quality and pace and help OpenAI learn through execution. This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. In this role, you will: - Own technical delivery for agreed semiconductor and AI-infrastructure workstreams, from initial scoping and prototypes through validation, production deployment and adoption. - Work closely with customer engineers to understand their workflows and constraints, define workloads, baselines and success criteria, and help what you build become part of how they work. - Scope and sequence delivery, identify dependencies and blockers early, and make practical trade-offs between scope, speed and quality as the work develops. - Personally build and debug production-quality software, including harnesses, integrations and product features that apply frontier models to problems in chip design, verification, inference and performance engineering. - Design reproducible experiments, evaluations, graders and benchmarks to test approaches, validate correctness and performance, and establish whether improvements hold up in real engineering environments. - Investigate model behavior and failure modes alongside researchers, contributing evaluation or training data and targeted experiments where they can improve the underlying capability. - Contribute directly to core product development, working with product engineers to resolve tooling gaps, ship useful improvements and bring field learning into product decisions. - Lead technical discussions and maintain alignment across customer, Product and Research teams. Build the domain and product fluency to explain capabilities, limitations and results, and keep ownership, risks and next steps clear. - Turn successful approaches into reusable software, tools and playbooks, reducing the effort needed for future engagements and helping customer teams operate what has been built. items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for an Android Engineer to join our growing mobile team and build the Creative App (Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.elevenlabs.coreapp&hl=en_GB), bringing our audio AI to millions of users. You’ll ship features that integrate tightly with our AI-driven audio models, and work out where focused bets or incremental improvements will move the product most. You’re impact-driven and autonomous, and good at drawing clear conclusions from experimental results. You’ll work closely with design, product and research, and help shape the app’s architecture and technical direction. Requirements - Strong native Android development (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose) with a track record of shipping features that improved engagement - Have designed and run A/B tests, using data to decide what to build next - Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-changing priorities, and able to add structure where it’s needed - Experience owning performance, quality and responsiveness in a production app Bonus - Experience with audio playback or streaming on Android - Experience building mobile infrastructure for build, test and release pipelines Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with the ability to operate in GMT to GMT+4 timezones preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, Dublin, Amsterdam and Paris. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Senior Web Engineer
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is looking for a Senior Web Engineer to own complex frontend features, improve reliability, and help us ship faster with confidence. You'll own major web surfaces end-to-end: from scoping and implementation through launch, monitoring, and production support. This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of frontend product development, backend systems, performance, and reliability. You should have experience in crypto and be comfortable shipping complicated React/Next.js features, debugging ambiguous production issues, and working across teams without needing hand-holding. We want someone who can move fast, make strong technical decisions, and help raise the quality bar for our frontend systems. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own and ship complex features end-to-end. Build and launch web features across Polymarket's core product surfaces, making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, architecture, and long-term maintainability. - Collaborate across the stack. Work closely with backend engineers to design APIs, reason through data flows, and build reliable user experiences on top of complex systems. Partner with QA, TPM, product, and design to clarify requirements, manage launches, and improve product quality. - Own reliability and incident response for your domain. Monitor dashboards, alerts, and user reports to identify and respond to issues quickly. Work with backend and infrastructure teams during incidents to isolate root causes, ship mitigations, and follow through with fixes and prevention work. - Improve frontend observability. Build and improve the logs, metrics, alerts, dashboards, and error reporting that give the team visibility into how our frontend systems are performing. - Raise the engineering bar. Identify meaningful technical debt, propose pragmatic refactors, and contribute to system design discussions that evolve our frontend architecture as the product scales. Lead by example through strong code reviews, clear communication, and high-quality execution. - Tie technical work to outcomes. Connect your work to measurable results – performance, reliability, product quality, and conversion – and help break down ambiguous product requirements into shippable engineering work. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 5+ years of frontend web engineering experience with experience in crypto, Web3, or adjacent financial infrastructure - Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend development - Strong frontend system design instincts across state management, data fetching, caching, performance, reliability, and maintainability - Experience owning complex features from scoping through launch - Strong debugging skills and experience responding to production issues - Comfortable working with backend engineers on APIs, data contracts, failure modes, and system behavior - High agency: you notice problems, propose solutions, and drive work to completion - Product-minded: you care about user experience, not just implementation - Able to operate independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment - Clear communicator during planning, launches, bugs, and incidents - (Plus) Frontend performance specialization - (Plus) Experience with high-traffic, real-time, marketplace, trading, or financial products - (Plus) Experience building for WebViews or shared web/mobile surfaces - (Plus) Experience improving frontend observability, alerting, or reliability practices - (Plus) Strong practical use of AI tools to improve engineering productivity BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $230,000 to $330,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

items.title: Analytics Engineer
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for an experienced Analytics Engineer to join our Data team as one of its first hires. You will own the transformation layer between raw data and business decisions: modelling our data in dbt, defining the certified metrics the company runs on, and setting the standards that every analyst and data scientist at ElevenLabs builds. - Drive the implementation of a world-class metric layer for the company: modelling conventions, project structure, testing, CI, and documentation. - Design and maintain the certified KPI layer for product (activation, adoption, retention, usage), finance (billing, ARR, revenue), and company-wide topics, built to withstand audit scrutiny. - Partner with Data Engineering on evolving the data warehouse architecture, and with stakeholders to turn ambiguous questions into trusted, reusable data products, including data served through AI agents. Requirements Demonstrated experience building and scaling a dbt project and metrics layer, ideally as one of the first analytics engineers on a growing team. - Expert knowledge of dbt and advanced SQL (required); strong grasp of dimensional modelling, grain, and incremental patterns. - Proficiency across the modern data stack (BigQuery or similar warehouse, Python, BI tools such as Looker). - Rigour around data quality: you test, document, and reconcile by default, and you spot a model that runs cleanly but is quietly wrong. - Strong ability to understand varied stakeholder requirements, push back where needed, and translate them into generalised, well-documented models. Bonus: - Experience modelling billing, subscription and ARR data (Stripe, Salesforce) or product event data at scale. - Experience serving data to LLM-based agents or building semantic / metrics layers consumed by AI tools. - Experience with CI for data (Slim CI, data contracts, PII policy tags) and infrastructure-as-code for warehouse access. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Talent Sourcer
items.location_text: United Kingdom, Brazil, Ireland, Portugal, Singapore, Hong Kong, Poland
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Our Global Sourcing team is looking for an exceptional Sourcer to help build the future of global finance at Payward. This is a high-bar role requiring extreme ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complex hiring challenges in a fully remote, high-agency, async-first environment where speed and quality are the standard. Main differentiators between this role and any other Sourcer role on the market: - Managing uncertainty: Payward is at the forefront of the innovation spectrum. As such, you can expect to tackle roles that you have never heard about, with no prior experience, data or track record - Subject matter expertise: We are building one interoperable stack connecting crypto, tokenized assets, and traditional markets. We are looking for experts in the fintech field, or deep thinkers able to bridge that gap quickly - Pace: You will be expected to flex your sourcing skills across Tech, Non-tech and anything in between with a very quick turnaround, across different payzones and businesses under the Payward umbrella, including Kraken, Ninjatrader and Reap. - Builder mentality: We are not looking for a plain executioner but someone that will contribute to building something new, awesome and cutting edge - Team work: Our sourcing team’s track record is unprecedented - we provide velocity and quality to our pipelines through hard work, but always working as a team. We have no room for solo players or internal competition In return, we offer the chance to leave a mark in one of the most innovative companies in the space as well as the opportunity to join a world-class and high-performance team. If you believe you have what it takes, continue reading below. THE OPPORTUNITY - Partner with Hiring Managers and Recruiters to design and execute effective hiring strategies - Gather, organise and communicate competitive market intelligence, identifying where target talent exists and sharing industry trends - Collaborate with the broader sourcing team in leveraging best practices across research techniques, boolean searches, tools, networking and other sourcing methods - Independently develop and maintain candidate flow across a variety of disciplines, leveraging data to drive decision making and process improvement - Source candidates through a variety of search resources (social media, internal database, job boards, networking, internet searches, etc.) - Be an ambassador to Kraken/Payward, sharing our values and drive brand awareness in the market - Participate in research projects and other initiatives which improve the infrastructure of hiring WHAT YOU BRING - Exceptional track record sourcing talent for reputable, fast-growing, high bar technology/product businesses against ruthless competition. Bonus points if you’ve hacked it in crypto, fintech or any product-driven org - High craft - Ability to translate hiring needs into accurate sourcing strategies; strong expertise in boolean/X-ray sourcing - High motor - Scrappiness - you do not see problems but opportunities - Strong product sense - Sound appreciation for the fundamentals of talent acquisition, but creative and inquisitive when considering modern tactics - High agency, strong bias for action, and the confidence to push boundaries, influence stakeholders, and close exceptional talent without compromise. - Comfort in the chaos, thriving in ambiguity, owning your outcomes, and moving with urgency in a fully async, remote-native setting - Ability to produce compelling market intelligence based on business and industry knowledge - Fintech/crypto understanding required. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Stay connected Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/krakenfx Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/ Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.kraken.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice

items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com. THE ROLE: Join the Genius team behind GeniusIQ, our live game tracking technology, and help build a brand-new Game Operations team in Estonia. You’ll help ensure our tracking and event data is accurate and on time, supporting the Game Operations team and leading a group of Operators during live football and basketball games. A fully remote hourly paid Service Provider position in Game Operations is a great fit if you: Want a flexible side hustle alongside your studies or main job Love sports and want to get your foot in the door of sports tech Are happy with routine tasks and enjoy being part of the live action WHAT YOU’LL DO: Set up and configure GeniusIQ software for live games Confirm correct tracking of dead balls, stoppage time and similar events Identify and confirm teams, lineups and players Stay alert during live play and report issues to your mentor Complete marking tasks that improve the accuracy of our system Lead a group of Operators on 1-2 football games per task Lead training for newly signed Operators WHAT YOU’LL BRING: Your own setup: a personal laptop or computer (not too old) with at least 512GB storage, and an internet connection of at least 50 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload Around 40-80 hours of tasks per month on average, mostly evenings, weekends and holiday periods , with fewer tasks in the summer (following the sports schedule). General computer literacy, particularly Excel or Google Sheets Football knowledge (any additional sport is a bonus) High attention to detail and the ability to focus in loud, distracting environments Extreme punctuality, as many tasks start near game start time Excellent communication skills, especially under pressure, to update your mentor and give feedback to Operators Ability to make time-sensitive judgment calls and collaborate with remote colleagues during live events As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports. Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

items.description: We are looking for a hands-on DevSecOps Engineer to join a fast-growing software development company delivering fintech and iGaming products. In this role, you will take ownership of security across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and development processes, helping build secure and scalable products. Responsibilities: - Drive the evolution of the company’s DevSecOps function by defining security initiatives, long-term priorities, and promoting a security-first engineering mindset - Partner with the DevOps team to improve the security and resilience of Kubernetes (EKS), Istio, Service Mesh, and related cloud-native infrastructure - Support engineering teams during service transitions by embedding security best practices into operational processes and ensuring effective knowledge sharing - Develop and maintain policy-as-code frameworks and infrastructure validation mechanisms using technologies such as OPA and other compliance automation tools - Improve the security of infrastructure provisioning and deployment workflows across Terraform, Ansible, and other Infrastructure-as-Code solutions - Integrate, maintain, and optimise security testing and scanning capabilities throughout the software development and release lifecycle - Build automation around security monitoring, compliance checks, and operational controls to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort Requirements: - Strong practical understanding of modern DevOps principles and secure CI/CD pipeline design - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes or other enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms - Proven experience working with Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or equivalent tools - Solid background in administering production infrastructure, including web servers, databases, and supporting services - Good understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing principles, and the OSI model - Experience securing distributed systems and microservices-based architectures - Proficiency with Git or other source code version control platforms - Practical experience securing cloud environments, preferably AWS, though experience with GCP or other major cloud providers is also valuable - Ability to assess infrastructure security posture, identify vulnerabilities, and implement appropriate remediation measures - Experience implementing identity and access management controls together with security automation practices - Hands-on knowledge of secrets management platforms (such as Vault) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions - Experience integrating SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container scanning, or similar security tooling into CI/CD workflows - Good understanding of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) principles and familiarity with security maturity frameworks such as OWASP SAMM v2 - English level: Upper-intermediate or higher What’s in it for you: - Fully remote working format - Competitive salary based on experience - Paid annual leave and sick leave - Opportunities for professional and career growth - Supportive environment focused on continuous development and long-term growth

items.title: Casino Specialist
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Casino Specialist to join our team in Malta. Reporting directly to the Casino Manager, you will sit at the intersection of product operations, commercial strategy, and provider management. In this role, you will take full ownership of day-to-day operations across assigned markets and brands. Your focus will be keeping our lobbies fresh and commercially optimized, coordinating game releases, troubleshooting operational issues, and partnering with game providers to secure promotional budgets and exclusive games. This is an ideal position for someone with solid gaming product experience who enjoys autonomy, works well under pressure, and wants to make an immediate impact on our core casino performance. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Managing daily casino operations across assigned markets, ensuring seamless game launches and optimal lobby positioning. - Building strong relationships with game providers to negotiate marketing co-funding, promotional campaigns, and exclusive releases. - Monitoring product performance metrics and delivering clear, actionable presentations to commercial cluster teams. - Acting as the main point of escalation for operational bugs, digging into root causes, and resolving issues directly with providers. - Collaborating closely with Marketing, Delivery, and Compliance teams to launch new initiatives smoothly and compliantly. - Representing LeoVegas Group at industry conferences and evening partner networking events. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - 1–2+ years of hands-on experience in iGaming product operations, casino coordination, or gaming delivery. - Strong commercial understanding of casino games, lobby management, and promotional mechanics. - Practical experience tracking product KPIs, analyzing performance data, and presenting insights to internal stakeholders. - Excellent organizational skills with the confidence to prioritize tasks, set clear boundaries, and solve problems independently. - Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills, with a genuine interest in building external provider relationships. NICE TO HAVES - Hands-on experience with front-end CMS tools (such as Redstone) or casino back-office platforms. - Existing network across top game suppliers, or experience utilizing modern AI tools (e.g. Claude) to optimize daily workflows. WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle - Private health insurance - Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants - We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments. JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: Senior Backend .NET Software Engineer - Payments
items.description: About the Role Are you an experienced Senior Backend Software Engineer ready for your next challenge? The Payments Engineering Area is hiring! Payments Engineering is responsible for building the best payment customer experience from payment pages perspective and improving the offering of different payment options across global brands and markets that we operate within. We are an international team with some of the best people in the industry! If you are passionate about the latest technologies and can handle company-critical responsibilities, then this is the role for you! What You’ll Work On Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable server-side applications using the .NET framework and related technologies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including front-end developers, product managers, and designers, to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications. Develop and implement efficient and secure RESTful APIs and microservices to support client applications and integrations. Perform thorough testing and debugging of backend applications to ensure high quality and reliability. Optimise application performance and scalability through code optimisations, caching strategies, and database optimisations. Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, adherence to architectural guidelines, and best practices. What You Bring Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS). Strong background in backend development, with experience in languages such as C#/.Net Knowledge of NoSQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server databases. Experience in design and implementation of distributed systems that comprise of multiple domain-oriented services. Understanding of front-end development technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Familiarity with version control systems, preferably Git. Familiarity with containerisation technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes. Strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns. Proficiency in SQL databases both in writing queries and optimising performance Effective communication skills in English, both verbal and written, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Stay updated with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in backend development and actively contribute to improving development processes and efficiency. Nice to Have Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. We don’t expect you to be an expert in all these technologies but would anticipate experience with some combined with a curiosity for others: etcd, Consul, Redis, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, gRPC, Orleans. We’re Swedish and publicly listed too with our Operational HQ located on the Mediterranean Island of Malta. We strive to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. As a market leader within iGaming we offer online gaming products across 12+ jurisdictions and 20+ brands. You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi-brand platform used by hundreds of thousands of our customers! Product Development at Betsson Group Our Product Development organisation is truly Global with cross functional teams spanning 6 Tech Hubs – Malta, Budapest, Stockholm, Tallinn, Malaga and Athens. With around 1,000 strong professionals, the Product Development organisation is spear-headed by our CTO-CPO with all our talented Area Teams working together. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your next step, please submit your CV in English. By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.title: Junior VIP Host - English Speaking
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We’re looking for a Junior VIP Host to build meaningful relationships and deliver personalised service to Stake’s most valued players at Easygo a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and live-streaming platforms. You’ll become a trusted point of contact for your own portfolio of VIP players, working closely with our wider VIP team to ensure every player feels valued, supported, and engaged. What you'll build with us: We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity based in Melbourne, with a unique split-shift structure combining time in our office with remote evening work to support our global VIP community. . You’ll manage a dedicated portfolio of approximately 350 VIP players , building lasting relationships through proactive communication, personalised rewards, and tailored experiences. Alongside resolving customer enquiries, you’ll develop a deep understanding of Stake’s products and player behaviours, helping us continually elevate the VIP experience. Who is Easygo? We're a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We're building the future of fearless tech. We're the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that's where the real fun happens. We're always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you'll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can't get anywhere else. Please note that in this role our team works 6 days a week for 6 hours a day. Your hours and location of work are below: Mon - Friday - 9am - 2pm (Office) Mon - Friday - 9pm - 11pm (Home) Saturday Or Sunday: 9am - 2pm + 9pm - 11pm (Home) The impact you’ll make: Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with a dedicated portfolio of approximately 350 VIP players, delivering personalised service that makes every interaction count. Act as the primary point of contact for your VIP players, understanding their individual preferences, needs and behaviours to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Proactively engage with players to build rapport, strengthen relationships and encourage long-term loyalty. Manage player enquiries from start to finish, ensuring timely responses, effective problem-solving and positive outcomes. Deliver tailored rewards, bonuses and cashback offers in line with established processes and player needs. Use communication platforms including live chat, email and Telegram to maintain meaningful and consistent engagement with VIP players. Monitor player activity, behaviours and trends, using insights to identify opportunities to improve the overall VIP experience. Collaborate with internal teams to resolve complex enquiries, escalate concerns and ensure a seamless player experience. Work closely with VIP Managers, Supervisors and Senior Hosts to achieve team KPIs and continuously improve service standards. Your track record: Minimum 1 year's experience in a customer service environment, ideally within hospitality, sales, account management or a similar customer-facing role. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build genuine relationships and adapt your approach to different personalities. A customer-first mindset with a genuine passion for delivering exceptional, personalised service. Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, particularly when managing challenging customer interactions. Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple conversations and priorities simultaneously. A proactive, solutions-focused approach with the ability to take ownership of customer enquiries and follow through to resolution. Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn new systems, products and processes. Comfortable working towards KPIs and contributing to a collaborative, high-performing team. Confidence using digital communication platforms and customer management systems. Bonus points if you also have: Previous experience within the wagering, iGaming or online casino industry. Knowledge of cryptocurrency, sports betting or casino products. Experience managing customer portfolios, VIP relationships or customer retention. Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Jira or Intercom. Benefits that give you the Easygo Edge, so you can build the future of fearless tech with us: Disrupt: we push boundaries and play to win Ballots for major sporting and music events Time with our partners and ambassadors, and exclusive office sessions with leading streamers, creators and industry guests Spin the Wheel Fridays on your birthday and work anniversary, with prizes up to $1,000 or a car EV subscriptions, novated leasing, energy savings through Origin, and everyday discounts and cash back through Paylab Rewards Evolve: we’re in constant motion, personally and professionally The ultimate sandbox: 1 in 3 of our people level up their role every year. If you deliver, you move. Market-synced pay, a performance-based bonus and a high-value referral bonus 30 days combined annual and personal leave for full-time employees 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers and 2 weeks for secondary carers, plus a 12-week return to work with fully paid Fridays off Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, and 7% off Bupa health cover with extras waiting periods waived Wednesday massages, a meditation space, parenting facilities, and bike storage, lockers and showers for active commuters Unify: we move as one and win together Daily catered breakfast, free barista coffee, juices and smoothies, and snack walls and drink fridges on every floor Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles, an F1 simulator, social sports teams and the Corporate Games Mid-year and end-of-year celebrations, team budgets for wins and milestones, and a paid volunteer day each year Benefits apply to Australian-based employees, are subject to eligibility and program terms, and may change. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Applied AI Architect, OpenAI for Government
items.description: About the Team The OpenAI for Government AI Architect team partners with public sector organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with government agencies, public institutions, and partner organizations serving the government to identify where AI can advance critical missions, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Global Affairs, and specialist delivery teams to help public sector customers adopt advanced AI responsibly and effectively. About the Role As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will shape each customer's AI strategy and guide their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable mission impact. You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate mission priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value. The Account Director leads the overall account strategy and relationship, while you lead the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production impact. You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong public sector fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations. This role is based in Munich or London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of public sector customers and pre-sales prospects. - Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities. - Lead discovery with agency leaders, mission owners, executives, and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful mission and operational outcomes. - Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment. - Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, building confidence in both the solution and its path to production. - Help customers navigate the security, compliance, governance, and deployment requirements that shape AI adoption in the public sector. - Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans. - Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Chief Data and AI Officers, program leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders. - Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, security, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams. - Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged. - Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable mission impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization. - Apply public sector and mission expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities. - Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success. - Have guided complex organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable impact. - Have experience working with government agencies, public institutions, or government contractors and understand how mission priorities, security, compliance, governance, and procurement considerations shape technology adoption. - Build credibility with senior technical and government leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers and program teams. - Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy. - Understand modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, and enterprise AI workflows. - Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript. - Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to establish clear handoffs and ownership. - Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes. - Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant public sector mission or customer segment. - Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan. - Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping public sector organizations deploy advanced AI safely and responsibly. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

items.title: Identity Engineer
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? The Identity Engineer will help build - not just run - a new identity platform that every person and system at Easygo authenticates through. What you’ll build with us: It’s a greenfield project: standing up a modern cloud identity platform, and operationalising it. The foundation is only the start and we have so much more to build on top of that. Alongside delivery, you'll grow into an identity subject-matter expert — partnering with engineering and product teams so they can build fast without having to worry about identity, making secure authentication, authorisation the easy path. Success requires strong hands-on identity engineering skill, a collaborative and proactive mindset, clear communication, and the ability to balance reliable day-to-day operations with continuous improvement in a fast-moving environment. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Build and administer the workforce identity platform, including sign-on and MFA policies, applications, groups and connectors — across multiple environments and entities. Configure and maintain authentication and authorisation: SSO (SAML, OIDC/OAuth 2.0), adaptive/conditional access, MFA enrolment and recovery, and session policy. Engineer and support identity governance (IGA) capability as it matures, including access requests, approvals, time-bound and privileged access, and periodic recertification. Own and improve the IaC (configuration as code) (e.g. Terraform) to make changes reviewable, repeatable and promotable across environments. Automate recurring identity operations to reduce manual effort and handoffs, tracking that reduction as a measure of impact. Design and tune risk-based authentication: use various signals to challenge or block risky sign-ins in real time to drive detections and automated response. Act as a go-to identity subject-matter expert and escalation point for IDAM across the business, including platform risks, cross-system issues and incidents, ensuring corrective and preventative actions are documented and implemented. Your track record: Essential 4+ years’ hands-on identity and access engineering in a mid-to-large or fast-growing organisation, owning an enterprise IdP end-to-end and experience in identity migration projects. Strong practical experience with a workforce IdP (PingOne highly regarded; equivalent enterprise IdP experience such as Okta, ForgeRock or similar is transferable). Experience treating identity as code — Terraform or similar IaC, version control, and CI/CD-style change management. Experience with AI coding and agent tools such as Claude, Cursor or Copilot as part of daily engineering. Bonus points if you also have: Experience with implementing PAM solutions on an enterprise level is highly desirable. Understands common identity architecture patterns (identity-aware proxy, service-to-service authentication, token exchange and delegation, federation) Exposure to security of AI agents: delegated (on-behalf-of) access, scoped and short-lived credentials, MCP server authorisation, prompt-injection risks, and keeping humans in the loop for high-impact actions Background in a technology, gaming or high-growth environment operating across multiple regions. Benefits that give you the Easygo Edge, so you can build the future of fearless tech with us: Disrupt: we push boundaries and play to win Ballots for major sporting and music events Time with our partners and ambassadors, and exclusive office sessions with leading streamers, creators and industry guests Spin the Wheel Fridays on your birthday and work anniversary, with prizes up to $1,000 or a car EV subscriptions, novated leasing, energy savings through Origin, and everyday discounts and cash back through Paylab Rewards Evolve: we’re in constant motion, personally and professionally The ultimate sandbox: 1 in 3 of our people level up their role every year. If you deliver, you move. Market-synced pay, a performance-based bonus and a high-value referral bonus 30 days combined annual and personal leave for full-time employees 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers and 2 weeks for secondary carers, plus a 12-week return to work with fully paid Fridays off Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, and 7% off Bupa health cover with extras waiting periods waived Wednesday massages, a meditation space, parenting facilities, and bike storage, lockers and showers for active commuters Unify: we move as one and win together Daily catered breakfast, free barista coffee, juices and smoothies, and snack walls and drink fridges on every floor Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles, an F1 simulator, social sports teams and the Corporate Games Mid-year and end-of-year celebrations, team budgets for wins and milestones, and a paid volunteer day each year Benefits apply to Australian-based employees, are subject to eligibility and program terms, and may change. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.
